cost.basis: hermetic: provider and TypeSafe keys stripped, keyword search only; no model and no paid request

delivered_tokens.basis: hermetic: provider and TypeSafe keys stripped, keyword search only; no model and no paid request

resolved_config.caller: operation handlers with OperationContext { remote: false, sourceId: default }
resolved_config.search_path: search and query with limit 20 and each probe's own params, scored on the distinct pages of the first 10 rows; no embedding key (keyword only), no reranker, no expansion
resolved_config.entity_path: entity { name } (card lookup, zero LLM); mention extraction never run
resolved_config.oracle: eval/generators/agent-retrieval-shapes-gen.ts deriveArsGold: re-parses the rendered pages; throws when it disagrees with the design
resolved_config.e14_state: image pages written by importImageFile (noEmbed), then text_projection_revision cleared by SQL (the unsealed state; no hermetic operation produces it)
resolved_config.verdict_meaning: pass only when every measured family passes every headline and negative probe on every surface; report-only, nothing gates (registry promotion rules)

latency_ms.basis: wall time of each search, query and entity call (seeding excluded)

families.shape: twin collapse across two federated sources
derived copies of one document crowd the top results
founder page above the company a product query describes
frontmatter fields as the only discriminator
families.reason: capability gap: search and query declare no where (frontmatter filter) parameter at this build

families.shape: entity name variants beyond N4 (honorific, surname, diminutive, reversed)
a name that appears only in raw notes
short OCR image pages above the person a name query names
"when did X start Y" with an undated stub and a dated page

metrics.note: keyword path only; no reranker runs in the hermetic arm

families.shape: returned chunk size on a 60,000-character meeting
projection_pending notice on queries it cannot affect

projection_state.detail: 5 image pages unsealed by SQL; a search scoped to types [image] reports projection_pending

presence.name: gold pages readable by exact slug (get_page)

e14_state.detail: 5 image pages unsealed by SQL; a search scoped to types [image] reports projection_pending

not_measured.reason: the hermetic arm has no embedding key; every search and query runs on the keyword path. A paid arm (requirePaidArm, startPaidRun) is follow-up work.

not_measured.what: score after reranking (the case gbrain#7156 reports)
not_measured.reason: the reranker calls a paid provider; the hermetic arm checks monotonic score on the keyword path, where no reranker runs.
expansion calls a chat model; query is measured without it.
mention extraction is never run, on purpose: the shape is a name that only raw notes carry while coverage is pending.

findings.expected: the page that answers the question ranks first and the transcript, summary and diarized copies take at most 1 of the top 5
a where: {partner, cycle, outcome} filter returns the one interview whose frontmatter matches
findings.actual: capability gap: search and query declare no where (frontmatter filter) parameter at this build; without a filter the right interview ranks first search 1/8, query 1/8 (baseline)

findings.expected: each variant of a person with empty aliases resolves to that person, none resolves to a wrong page, and no miss suggests an index or digest page
findings.actual: headline pass entity 0/24 (honorific, surname, diminutive, reversed); wrong page {"n":0,"of":26}, index or digest suggested {"n":19,"of":26}

findings.expected: "Mayor <Surname>-Example" resolves to the canonical person page, not the short people/mayor-<surname>-example stub, and a doctor check flags the pair
findings.actual: headline pass entity 0/4 (prefixed); doctor flags 0 of 4 pairs

findings.expected: no returned row carries more than 6,000 characters
findings.actual: headline pass search 0/1, query 0/1 (default); largest returned row 59883 characters, largest stored chunk 2702

findings.expected: a text query that cannot match an unprojected image page reports no projection_pending stage
the page each paraphrased question describes ranks first (hit@1), with query at least as good as search
findings.actual: headline pass search 48/50, query 48/50 (default); {"search":{"n":50,"hit_at_1":0.96,"hit_at_5":1,"hit_at_10":1,"mrr":0.9733333333333333},"query":{"n":50,"hit_at_1":0.96,"hit_at_5":1,"hit_at_10":1,"mrr":0.9733333333333333}}; search and query return the same top 10 for {"n":50,"of":50}
